description: Per-layout fixes that are no placement, made on the layout files before the game GUI engine wraps and measures them: layouts maps a layout of the arrangement to its fixes. hide: panes made clear (alpha 0; a whole root group is hidden by its block instead); backdrop: a root group stretched over the whole top screen (the touch screen's 320 x 240 ground made 400 wide); nudge: panes inside a root group moved by [right, down] pixels at the layout's own size (the file's units; the block's scale then scales them with the rest); fill: a copy of a sprite ('otherlayout:sprite' for another layout of the ARC) inserted as the first child of a root group, over the whole top screen unless over / margin name a box, with its own color when today's mechanism hides the template (single_screen.json's fill record).
